public_rationale: The presentation supplied development steps and a tentative three-to-five-year delivery window. These constitute a preliminary road map under the stated reading. Whether the schedule was credible or later achieved is a separate question.
limitations: The schedule was tentative and lacked a detailed commercial rollout plan.
This does not adjudicate the word 'bluster'.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The Optimus presentation contained bluster about productivity but no road map.

statement.excerpt: There was a lot of bluster (we will 100x the world’s productivity) but no road map.

our_interpretation: The checkable core is whether the September 30, 2022 presentation supplied a development or deployment road map.
An ordinary road map can be preliminary: a sequence of intended steps, milestones or delivery timing. It need not be a binding schedule.
'Bluster' is an evaluative description. This assessment does not test whether the productivity aspiration would eventually be achieved.
criteria.support_condition: The presentation contains aspirations but no development or deployment steps, milestones or timing.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The presentation states development milestones, an intended deployment sequence or a delivery timeframe.
